records.title: Backyard Day/Night — Historical WebGL2 Study
records.summary: A self-contained, interactive WebGL2 day/night experiment preserving an earlier 181-part scene snapshot, before a later geometry correction.
records.limitations: Historical 181-part snapshot, not the corrected 179-part production source. WebGL2 is required; physical GPU identity, cross-backend parity and new human artistic review are not established.

records.title: Backyard Inverted-Hull Outline — Rejected Study
records.summary: Preserved rejected geometry-shell outline technique using archived 181-part WebGL2 scene data.
records.limitations: Artistic technique rejected; runtime viability is a separate question. Historical geometry; not a corrected production scene or approved exhibition.

records.title: Backyard Screen-Space Outlines — Experimental Follow-Up
records.summary: Follow-up depth/normal-buffer outline experiment against the archived 181-part WebGL2 scene.
records.limitations: Experimental alternative, not accepted as a production effect; archived geometry, no comparative benchmark or gallery approval.
